text:
maria: heads-up — thinking about plan-aware fallback budgets for routing. want to land a small API + console flow for editing/previewing per-plan failover rules.

mike: what's in scope for "budget"? tokens vs concurrency vs time window?

maria: two dims: soft_deficit_tokens (daily cap of tokens allowed to hit cheaper variant) and burst_window_seconds (transient concurrency allowance). also a fallback_sequence per tenant.

priya: + API suggestion: explicit fields and telemetry hooks. example payload:

```json
{"routing_policy":{"plan":"pro","soft_deficit_tokens":200000,"burst_window_seconds":30,"fallback_sequence":["rw-4q","rw-4q-int8","open-3b"],"telemetry_hooks":["fallback","quota_exhausted","hard_reject"]}}
```

elaine: console: show per-tenant "runway" meter (tokens left) + timeline events. add quick "grant runway" button with audit log.

tony: enterprise may want fallback disabled. free can be aggressive. need to ensure SLA docs reflect this and billing doesn't surprise.

mike: control plane should compute effective policy (merge: plan preset < tenant overrides < region override) and push to runtime. runtime remains fast and dumb.

priya: add a preview API so console shows diff between preset and effective policy before applying.

elaine: support tip: "why did X request fall back" modal with exact decision rule (e.g. ran out of soft_deficit_tokens) + link to tenant's runway dashboard.

.deploy-bot: deploy request: feature/plan-fallback -> staging (canary 8%) by @maria

maria: actions:
- mike: control-plane merge + policy export API sketch by Wed
- priya: console preview + runway meter mock by Thu
- elaine: templated "why fallback" messages + support doc
- tony: enterprise SLA exemptions + legal check

priya: API naming nit: prefer soft_deficit_tokens (agreed in thread)

mike: will include cardinality limits for telemetry events and example observability queries for fallback rate and latency delta

maria: i'll draft RFC and ping infra/product channels. ok to close this thread and link the RFC?

tony: fine. include a quick checklist for QA (tenant with overrides, region override, zero-runway enterprise case)

maria: thanks all :rocket:
